summary: Evolution Metals & Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing it will miss the extended deadline to file its Q1 2026 Form 10-Q due to accounting complexities from a large overseas equipment purchase. The filing provides unaudited interim financials as an exhibit and warns of a potential Nasdaq non-compliance notice under Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). There is no special-situation event; this is a routine late-filing disclosure with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate action. Focus on the timeline for regaining Nasdaq compliance.
